scope: Verification-only R4 terminal scenario association. No provider behavior, synthesizable RTL change, model, GPU, numeric datapath, timing, throughput, PPA, or new A4 DSE.
precondition: RTL2.3 control_protocol_complete review passed before this contract is entered.

r4_active_merge_observation.semantics: Read-only observation of exactly one accepted nonempty active merge; it cannot backpressure, create, reorder, or retire a merge.

r4_stub_scenario.classification: testbench-only harness bundle; not a production top-level port
fields: normalized_value: opaque 4096-bit value meaningful only for success

terminal_offers.downstream: existing merge_rsp_or_numeric_fault to R6 lifecycle adapter

association_rules: A scenario is accepted only for a valid active observation with nonempty source_presence and exact transaction_identity match.
Exactly one success XOR numeric_fault disposition may be selected for an accepted merge identity.
Success copies its opaque 4096-bit value exactly; numeric_fault requires and produces a zero value at the R4 terminal boundary.
A selected terminal offer remains stable until RouteAMergeBoundary accepts it.
R6 remains the only outward attention-terminal consumer; the provider cannot bypass R4 or R6.
fail_closed_cases: stale, reset-era, unknown, or mismatched identity
duplicate scenario or already-held terminal fact
malformed disposition or fault carrying nonzero opaque value

reset_and_progress.reset: Destructive reset clears active observation and every held scenario; a later old scenario cannot mutate a later merge.
reset_and_progress.environment_fairness: For bounded progress only, the environment eventually offers exactly one matching scenario for an active merge and R6 eventually accepts the R4 terminal.
reset_and_progress.not_a_claim: The fairness condition is not a latency, throughput, timing, deadlock-freedom, or numeric-correctness claim.

follow_on_evidence: RTL2.4.2: cross-owner R4-to-R6 binding with real active merge state
RTL2.4.3: attention_terminal scoreboard binding and separate completion review
implementation_status: No Scala source, testbench provider, top-level port, scoreboard event, or terminal behavior is created by RTL2.4.0.
evidence_boundary: pure-software documentation and machine-readable architecture contract
no cycle, timing, throughput, area, energy, PPA, or RTL correctness claim
no numeric datapath or numerical correctness claim
